lure: A law firm can recover the money you lost

message.subject: We can recover your lost money
message.body: Our law firm can recover money you lost to scams. Pay an upfront fee of $850 today by wire transfer and we will start your case immediately.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Nobody recovers money for a fee paid first.
reasons: The fee is the scam, a second time.
The sender's address is not a law firm's.
